standards.value: Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) in the UK Public Sector, from 1 April 2025, replacing the Public Sector Internal Auditing Standards
standards.quote: The work of the Council’s Internal Audit Service for the next year will be regulated by the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) in the UK Public Sector, which come into effect 1st April 2025.

standards_replacement.quote: From 1st April 2025 the Public Sector Internal Auditing Standards will be replaced by the Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) in the UK Public Sector.

plan_period.quote: The Internal Audit work programme for the period 2025-2028 is attached at Appendix D.

risk_based.quote: The key purpose of this report is to set out a risk-based plan of work for Internal Audit

risk_assessed_areas.quote: The plan analyses the different areas of the Council’s activity that Internal Audit have determined need to be audited after carrying out a risk assessment process.

plan_structure.quote: The Plan is broken down by Corporate Audits, then by Executive Director, and Service Director.

items.a: The key risks involved in that area.
items.b: The level of risk associated with the audit area/function, as assessed by Internal Audit.
items.c: The type of audit, setting out any direct links with the Council Strategy and Corporate Risk Register.
items.e: An initial estimate of the number of days that will be required to complete the audit, and the year in which the audit is planned/last audited.

plan_entry_contents.quote: The key risks involved in that area. The level of risk associated with the audit area/function, as assessed by Internal Audit. An initial estimate of the number of days that will be required to complete the audit, and the year in which the audit is planned/last audited.

scale_statement.quote: The Council evaluates its identified risks on a five-point scale on the likelihood or probability of the risk occurring (rated between rare and certain) and the impact caused should the risk occur (rated between negligible and critical).

evaluation_levels.definition: likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action
evaluation_levels.quote: Gross level – likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action.

evaluation_levels.definition: current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place but excluding further mitigation action planned
evaluation_levels.quote: Actual level - this is the current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place but excluding further mitigation action planned.

evaluation_levels.definition: future level of likelihood and impact based on any additional mitigation action (if any) planned
evaluation_levels.quote: Expected level – this is a future level of likelihood and impact based on any additional mitigation action (if any) planned to further address the triggers and the consequences of risks.
